items.question: Who controls the data?
items.answer: You retain full agency. No details are shared with employers or third parties without explicit consent.

items.question: Is this therapy?
items.answer: No. We focus on professional strategies and will signpost appropriate clinical help if needed.

items.question: Handling capacity?
items.answer: We use a 'pause clause' to suspend sessions during high-pressure periods to protect your wellbeing.
